theorem: General Borel-space fiber representation and norm identity
quantifiers: For every standard Borel probability space (Omega,mu), every positivity-preserving self-adjoint graphop A that is bounded L-infinity to L-infinity and L-one to L-one, with all identities understood up to mu-null sets

trusted_foundation.statement: lambda_A(S x T)=integral 1_S A1_T dmu is a bounded positive countably additive rectangle premeasure; monotone convergence supplies countable additivity.
trusted_foundation.source: Standard: monotone convergence and extension of positive bilinear forms

trusted_foundation.statement: A finite positive rectangle premeasure extends uniquely to the product sigma algebra.
trusted_foundation.source: Bogachev, Measure Theory: Caratheodory extension theorem

trusted_foundation.statement: Self-adjointness makes lambda_A(S x T)=lambda_A(T x S) on rectangles; uniqueness of extension gives symmetry on the product sigma algebra.
trusted_foundation.source: Standard: pi-lambda uniqueness for finite measures

trusted_foundation.statement: Disintegration of lambda_A with respect to mu gives a measurable finite kernel x maps to nu_x; the L-infinity bound makes its mass essentially bounded.
trusted_foundation.source: Kallenberg, Foundations of Modern Probability: disintegration on Borel spaces

trusted_foundation.statement: The identity holds for indicators by construction, for simple functions by linearity, and for every bounded measurable f by monotone-class approximation.
A countable generating pi-system for a standard Borel space identifies two kernels simultaneously outside one null set, then the pi-lambda theorem identifies all Borel sets.
trusted_foundation.source: Kallenberg, Foundations of Modern Probability: uniqueness of kernels on Borel spaces

trusted_foundation.statement: Positivity gives |Af|<=A1 for ||f||infinity<=1, while f=1 attains A1(x)=nu_x(Omega); hence the norm is ess sup_x nu_x(Omega).
trusted_foundation.source: Standard: norm of a positive kernel operator on L-infinity

trusted_foundation.statement: L-one/L-infinity duality and self-adjointness identify the two induced norms; the preceding positive-kernel calculation identifies both with the essential supremum.
trusted_foundation.source: Rudin, Functional Analysis: L-one/L-infinity duality for bounded operators

trusted_foundation.statement: The symmetric joint measure, measurable unique fibers, representation for all bounded signals, and exact common norm are precisely the forward content of the fiber theorem.
trusted_foundation.source: Definition in arXiv:2602.08785v1: bofop terminology; conclusion reconstructed from the listed standard lemmas

limitations: The trusted boundary is standard measure theory: extension, disintegration on standard Borel spaces, monotone classes, and Lp duality. Unlike the previous finite certificate, the derivation quantifies arbitrary standard Borel probability spaces and null-set equivalence.
